judged_text: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, causing an off-by-one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit — showingLast never becomes true and users can page into an empty page

record.issue_text: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, causing an off-by-one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit — showingLast never becomes true and users can page into an empty page

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`. When `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 100/50), this yields 3 pages instead of 2. As a result `showingLast` (`propertyEqual("currentPage", "totalPages")`) won’t become true on the real last page, and `actions.next` can advance `offset` to `user_count` (e.g., 100). `Group.findMembers` then requests members with `offset: 100`, and `GroupsController#members` applies `.limit(limit).offset(offset)`, returning an empty `members` list. This matches the reported empty-page behavior.
